purpose: W4-C: fail-close unsafe process-local elevator mutations and establish PostgreSQL-authoritative facility, intake, weighing correction, custody evidence, capacity and storage-position records without creating a second Inventory authority.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: W4-C uses a dedicated private elevator_storage PostgreSQL schema and trusted command boundary; no public Prisma model becomes authority.
Canonical Inventory remains the stock authority. Elevator records produce physical storage/custody evidence and capacity facts; they do not rewrite Inventory/title state directly.
Deal authority remains a consumer/reference; elevator intake cannot mutate Deal status directly in this foundation.
ElevatorModule is already mounted; no global module mutation is required.
Global CI remains an independent gate.
Generic additive migration checker remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: All production elevator mutations are PostgreSQL-authoritative; process-local Map state is removed from mutation authority and no audit/outbox failure is suppressed.
Tenant, Deal/lot, facility organization and actor authority are derived from current authenticated database context; caller elevatorOrgId or tenant fields never become authority.
Facility and storage capacity use exact integer pinned units. Float weight/capacity arithmetic is forbidden from authoritative records.
Intake records gross/tare/net observations, measurement source, device/manual provenance and occurredAt. Manual values remain declared observations, not independent verification by label alone.
Weighing correction appends a new immutable correction version with reason/actor/evidence and cannot rewrite a prior accepted observation.
Elevator custody evidence is distinct from legal title/disposal-right evidence. Physical possession at a facility cannot manufacture ownership or encumbrance clearance.
StoragePosition pins facility, storage cell/bin/warehouse location, commodity profile/version, quantity basis and custody period. Capacity cannot be exceeded by concurrent accepted positions.
Current membership/user/organization/facility capability is revalidated before command and replay; revocation prevents historical receipt replay from acting as current authority.
Cross-tenant and same-tenant outsider access to intake, weights, capacity, positions and custody evidence is denied under FORCE RLS.
Every accepted mutation commits aggregate state, immutable event, audit and outbox atomically with payload-bound idempotency and optimistic version checks.
Later Inventory/Progressive Trust integration consumes signed elevator evidence through explicit adapters; W4-C does not mutate Inventory verificationStatus or Deal state directly.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, packages/lockfiles, external provider claims and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Static/runtime regression proves process-local Map and caller elevatorOrgId are no longer mutation authority and audit failures fail the command closed.
Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove facility creation/read, intake, exact gross/tare/net arithmetic, correction versioning, capacity and storage positions.
Concurrent intake/storage allocation cannot exceed facility/storage capacity and produces deterministic conflict/stale outcomes.
Cross-tenant and same-tenant outsider reads/writes, revoked actor/facility authority and changed-payload replay fail closed.
Manual observations retain provenance and never self-promote ownership, FGIS status, legal title or VERIFIED trust state.
Audit/outbox/event failure leaves no partial elevator record or acknowledged command.
Elevator custody evidence can be referenced immutably by later Inventory/Verification adapters without changing its historical bytes/hash.
Forward migrations, zero public-schema drift, restore, cryptographic freshness, global CI and exact-head review pass without weakening independent gates.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Progressive Trust/Inventory must consume accepted elevator evidence before terminal ELEVATOR_VERIFICATION credit.
User-facing facility/intake/storage/correction flows and real device/manual workflows remain later UX acceptance.
External elevator integrations remain provider adapters and require separate live credentials/receipts if used.
Verified REG.RU runtime with real elevator operational acceptance remains required before terminal PASS.
